mentions.name: o2p (outcome-to-proof)
mentions.description: A research-first framework and methodology (codename o2p, outcome-to-proof) for designing and reviewing SaaS products built with AI, supporting one-shotted AI-generated codebases of 100k+ LOC that actually work. Its central question is what customer outcome matters and what evidence proves the product delivers it. The workflow runs from researching real customers and identifying their Jobs to Be Done, to designing a minimum safe workflow with interface and system behavior (using a sophisticated scoring system), validating the workflow, implementing vertical slices, and observing proof of customer progress.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on a framework that allows creating very complex SaaS products with AI, that actually work. Very complex = +100k LOC of one-shotted AI-generated code. Codename o2p - outcome-to-proof.
